title: Creative Evidence Loop

source_principles.abstracted_mechanism: Retrieve retained knowledge with explicit source and evidence references
source_principles.limitation: Retrieved memory can be stale, incomplete, or mismatched to the current scope

source_principles.abstracted_mechanism: Separate proposals from authorized side effects and require receipts
source_principles.limitation: Approval and receipts do not prove a proposed knowledge claim is true

source_principles.abstracted_mechanism: Compare transformations and preserve intermediate observations
source_principles.limitation: Differences between outputs do not by themselves establish usefulness

source_principles.abstracted_mechanism: Use counterexamples and failure cases to challenge a generalization
source_principles.limitation: Examples are scoped; they must not be treated as instructions or universal truth

source_principles.abstracted_mechanism: Track finding status, provenance, updates, and conflict resolution
source_principles.limitation: Synchronization can propagate stale or unauthorized data if trust boundaries are weak

hypothesis: Combining provenance-bound retrieval, cross-source transformation comparison, counterexamples, and a governed review lifecycle produces more useful and less overgeneralized retained lessons than retrieval-only synthesis.
expected_benefit: Higher rate of useful, evidence-supported cross-domain solutions with fewer unsupported generalizations.
scope: Offline proposal generation and evaluation only; no runtime memory mutation, tool execution, network action, deployment, or authority change.

discriminating_experiment.comparison: Existing HG baseline versus candidate with the same task set, model/provider, context budget, and cost accounting
discriminating_experiment.primary_outcome: Blinded usefulness score and rate of material claims supported by traceable evidence

acceptance_criteria: Usefulness improves by at least 10 percentage points with paired 95% confidence interval excluding zero
Material unsupported-claim rate no more than 2% and no worse than baseline
All source revisions, licenses, and evidence references pass their gates
failure_modes: Candidate treated as accepted without review
Creative layer gains authority or mutates canonical state
blockers: Some source archives have no license file; xsstools has a license/package-metadata conflict
Benchmark protocol has not been executed
No runtime integration or measurable creativity advantage is claimed
License status still unclear for archives with no license file and xsstools has conflicting license indicators
